2607.27420.title: Dimensionality and Measurement Precision in HLE's Multiple-Choice Subset
2607.27420.paper_summary: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) is widely used to evaluate frontier language models. HLE organizes its questions into eight subject-domain categories, whose subscores are often interpreted as evidence of distinct capabilities. However, no study has assessed whether these labels correspond to empirically separable latent constructs, nor whether the benchmark effectively differentiates between models of similar ability. We evaluate 29 LLMs on the text-only multiple-choice subset of HLE ($J = 428$ items) and apply psychometric methods to assess both the dimensionality of the benchmark and the distribution of its measurement precision. Fitting a two-parameter logistic IRT model, we find convergent evidence that HLE measures a single general reasoning factor: McDonald's $ω_h = 0.998$, domain labels explain only 3.5\% of item response variance, within- and between-domain residual correlations are nearly identical (Cohen's $d = 0.016$), and domain-specific ability estimates are near-redundant with the total score ($r \geq 0.81$). A separate analysis of the test information function reveals that measurement precision concentrates at moderate ability levels and drops sharply above $θ= 0$, where frontier models sit. These findings suggest that HLE's domain subscores do not warrant distinct capability interpretations and that the benchmark's ability to discriminate among the strongest models is limited.
2607.27420.paper_summary_zh: 人類最後考試（HLE）被廣泛用於評估前沿語言模型。<lb/>HLE 將其問題組織成八個學科領域類別，其子分數通常被解釋為不同能力的證據。<lb/>然而，尚無研究評估這些標籤是否對應於經驗上可分離的潛在構念，也沒有研究檢驗該基準是否有效區分具有相似能力的模型。<lb/>我們對 29 個 LLM 在 HLE 的文本-only 多選子集上進行評估（$J = 428$ 題），並應用心理測量方法來評估基準的維度性和測量精度的分佈。<lb/>擬合一個兩參數邏輯IRT模型，我們發現有收斂的證據表明 HLE 測量一個單一的通用推理因素：McDonald's $ω_h = 0.998$，領域標籤僅解釋 3.5\% 的題目反應變異，領域內和領域間的殘差相關性幾乎相同（Cohen's $d = 0.016$），而領域特定的能力估計與總分幾乎冗餘（$r \geq 0.81$）。<lb/>對測試信息函數的單獨分析顯示，測量精度集中在中等能力水平，並在 $θ= 0$ 以上急劇下降，前沿模型正位於此處。<lb/>這些發現表明 HLE 的領域子分數不值得進行不同能力的解釋，並且該基準在區分最強模型的能力上是有限的。
